maddeler.t:
مُجْتَمَع (mujtamaʕ, “community”) + مِيم (mīm, “the letter mīm”), literally “the community of mīm”.
Named so because مِثْلِيّ (miṯliyy, “gay”) + مِثْلِيَّة (miṯliyya, “lesbian”) + مُزْدَوِج المَيْل الجِنْسِي (muzdawij al-mayl al-jinsī, “bisexual”) + مُتَحَوِّل جِنْسِيًّا (mutaḥawwil jinsiyyan, “transgender”) all begin with the letter mīm.
s: مُجْتَمَع (mujtamaʕ, “community”) + مِيم (mīm, “the letter mīm”), literally “the community of mīm”
